purpose: Emphasize that something happened long before now.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express feelings speak politely show respect
I saw that film ages ago.
I thought he had left long ago.
restrictions: Often implies the listener is late to notice or ask.
mistake: Use with a completed event or already-established state.

segments.role: Emphasize that something happened long before now. とっくに + completed predicate
